entities.name: Jehadt
entities.description: A proud wizard and warder of Gordahn who vowed revenge after Mezlok defeated him.

entities.name: Mezlok
entities.description: A planeswalker named champion of Gordahn who defeated Jehadt easily.

entities.name: Mirrankkar
entities.description: The wizards' duel Jehadt trained for.

events.summary: Mezlok walks into Gordahn and the village leader announces he will be champion.
events.quote: the planeswalker Mezlok walked into the village, and the village's leader announced that Mezlok would be the village's champion

events.summary: Jehadt challenges Mezlok and is defeated easily.
events.quote: Jehadt challenged Mezlok for the right to represent the village, but Mezlok defeated him easily
